INT. ALL-NIGHT DINER - NIGHT

Rain against the window. JUNE (40s) stirs a coffee she has no
intention of drinking. LEO (30s) slides into the booth across from her.

                         LEO
               You came.

                         JUNE
               I said I would.

                         LEO
                    (beat)
               You said a lot of things.

June pushes the coffee across the table.

                         JUNE
               Drink that. You look terrible.

                         LEO
               Thanks.

He doesn't touch it.

                         LEO (CONT'D)
               When did he tell you?

                         JUNE
                    (quietly)
               Last night. He's selling the house.

                         LEO
               He can't. Mom's piano is still in
               the front room.

                         JUNE
               He can, Leo. It's his house.
